Very weak liquidity (current ratio 0.63), large accumulated deficit (retained earnings of -5,086M), and thin capitalization relative to liabilities (equity of 3,652M against 52,835M of liabilities) point to a highly leveraged and vulnerable credit profile. Positive EBIT provides some support, but on balance the metrics fit a speculative-grade issuer with meaningful default risk rather than imminent failure.

DECISION: B+
